Accounts.DisconnectConfirm: Disconnect {0}? The drive is unmounted and stops syncing. Cached data and settings are kept.
Accounts.ForceRemove: Remove even if changes are not uploaded yet (they will be lost)
Accounts.RemoveNote: Files in the cloud are not deleted. Other accounts are not affected.
Accounts.Subtitle: Add as many Google Drive and TeraBox accounts as you like. Accounts never share data.
Add.GoogleClientMissing: No Google OAuth client is configured. Open Settings → Google Drive OAuth client and enter your Desktop client ID (see docs/GOOGLE_SETUP.md).
Add.Privacy: You sign in on the provider's own page. SsdVirtual never sees your password; tokens are encrypted with Windows DPAPI.
Add.WaitingBrowser: Complete the sign-in in your browser…
Add.WrongAccount: This drive belongs to {0}, but you signed in as {1}.
Cache.ClearConfirm: Remove cached copies? Changes that are not uploaded yet and items kept offline are never removed.
Cache.LocationHelp: Choose a fast local SSD with enough free space. New data is staged here before it is uploaded.
Cache.MoveConfirm: Move the cache to {0}? All drives are unmounted briefly while data is moved.
Cache.NoPinned: Nothing is pinned. Use "Keep offline" in the File Manager or Game Storage.
Cache.NotOnVirtual: The cache cannot be placed on an SsdVirtual drive.
Cache.Subtitle: Local SSD cache that makes cloud files behave like local files.
Cache.VerifyResult: Checked {0} files, skipped {1} (no checksum or not fully cached), {2} corrupted copies discarded.
Cache.WriteBack: Write-back (upload after the file is closed and idle)
Cache.WriteThrough: Write-through (upload immediately when the file is closed)
Dashboard.NoDrivesHelp: Add a Google Drive or TeraBox account. Every account becomes its own drive letter in File Explorer.
Dashboard.ServiceHelp: The background service mounts the drives and keeps them working without this window. It is installed by the SsdVirtual installer.
Dashboard.Subtitle: Your cloud storage as local Windows drives.
Dashboard.WinFspHelp: SsdVirtual needs the WinFsp file system driver to create drives. Run the SsdVirtual installer again to install it.
Disks.CapacityUnknown: Capacity not known yet (connect to refresh)
Disks.Subtitle: Each account is a separate drive with its own namespace, cache and sync.
Error.ServiceUnavailable: SsdVirtualService is not running. Start it from the Dashboard or reinstall SsdVirtual.
Files.DeleteConfirm: Delete {0} items? On cloud drives they go to the cloud's trash.
Files.Name: Name
Games.LibraryCreated: Created {0}. Add it in Steam → Settings → Storage.
Games.LibraryExists: {0} already exists. Add it in Steam → Settings → Storage if it is not listed yet.
Games.MoveConfirm: Move {0} into {1}? The source is deleted after a complete copy.
Games.MoveCopy: Move or copy a game folder
Games.MoveCopyHelp: Choose a game folder and a target folder on a virtual drive. For Steam games prefer Steam's own "Move install folder" so Steam updates its records.
Games.None: No games found on mounted drives.
Games.PickTarget: Choose the target folder (on a virtual drive)
Games.PinHelp: Games run reliably only when fully cached. "Keep offline" downloads every file of the game into the local cache and keeps it there.
Games.SteamLibraryHelp: Creates X:\SteamLibrary on the chosen drive. Then in Steam open Settings → Storage → Add drive and pick that drive.
Games.Subtitle: Use virtual drives as game libraries. Pinned games are fully cached and run like a local install.
Perf.BenchmarkHelp: Writes a test file to the drive, reads it back (sequential and random 4 KiB) and deletes it. This measures the local cache path; reading data that is not cached yet depends on your internet connection.
Perf.Result: Sequential write {0} MB/s · sequential read {1} MB/s · random 4 KiB read {2} IOPS ({3} MB test file, measured just now)
Perf.Subtitle: Live measurements from SsdVirtualService.
Settings.BackupHelp: Exports settings and drive options (no credentials). Importing restores settings for accounts that exist on this PC.
Settings.CustomLanguageHelp: Translate template.json, save it under another name in the custom language folder and choose it here.
Settings.DiagnosticsSaved: Diagnostics saved. They contain no passwords or tokens.
Settings.GoogleClientHelp: Google requires each app to use its own OAuth client. Create a "Desktop app" client in Google Cloud Console with the Drive API enabled (docs/GOOGLE_SETUP.md), then enter it here or import the downloaded JSON.
Settings.StartWithWindows: Start the SsdVirtual tray app when I sign in
Settings.StartupHelp: Drives are mounted by SsdVirtualService before you sign in, so they are available even when this app is closed.
Settings.TransfersHelp: Limits apply to all accounts together. The schedule only affects background uploads; reading files is always allowed.
Sync.ConflictHelp: When a file changed both here and in the cloud, the cloud version keeps the name and your version is saved next to it as "name (Conflict date).ext".
Sync.Subtitle: Uploads, cloud changes and conflicts. Local changes are journaled and never lost when you go offline.
Sync.Summary: {0} files to upload · {1} pending operations · {2} conflicts
TeraBox.Consent:
You are signed in to TeraBox.

SsdVirtual will now store this TeraBox web session (encrypted with Windows DPAPI) so the drive can access your files. TeraBox has no public API, so this uses the same web interface as your browser and may stop working if TeraBox changes it.

Allow SsdVirtual to use this session?
TeraBox.LoginHint: Sign in on the official TeraBox page below. This browser window is isolated and is deleted afterwards.
TeraBox.NoWebView2: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required for TeraBox sign-in. Install it from https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703
Transfers.Subtitle: Uploads, offline downloads and their progress.
